query_texts.name: Generic
query_texts.Text:
SELECT $AddSPCAnnotationHistory.InstanceId         AS @fieldheader:name="InstanceId",
       $AddSPCAnnotationHistory.Annotation         AS @fieldheader:name="Annotation",
       $AddSPCAnnotationHistory.DataCollectionDef  AS @fieldheader:name="DataCollectionDef",
       $AddSPCAnnotationHistory.DataCollectionName AS @fieldheader:name="DataCollectionName",
       $AddSPCAnnotationHistory.DataPoint          AS @fieldheader:name="DataPoint",
       $AddSPCAnnotationHistory.DataPointName      AS @fieldheader:name="DataPointName",
       $AddSPCAnnotationHistory.Exclude            AS @fieldheader:name="Exclude", 
       $AddSPCAnnotationHistory.SPCChartDef        AS @fieldheader:name="SPCChartDef" 
  FROM $HistoryMainline,  
       $AddSPCAnnotationHistory
 WHERE HistoryMainline.HistoryMainlineId                       = $AddSPCAnnotationHistory.Parent
   AND HistoryMainline.HistoryId                               = ?DataPoint
   AND HistoryMainline.ReversalStatus                          = 1
ORDER BY $AddSPCAnnotationHistory.InstanceId

result.name: DataCollectionDef
result.FieldDescription: The Data Collection Definition used to define the parametric data fields to collect and place in ParametricData.  If there is only one reference to this specific service in the Spec TransactionMap, InSite will fill in this field automatically.  If a service exists multiple times in the TransactionMap, the user will need to input which data collection definition they are using.  For instance, the CollectData service might be entered twice on the TransactionMap, once with parameters recorded every hour, and once with parameters recorded every ten minutes.  When the user is performing the ColllectData, the user would then need to specify which kind of data collection they are performing in this field.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.FieldDescription: DisplayName is the field generally used to represent an object in a user interface, especially when the user interface needs to represent an object with just one data element.  For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object.   The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character.   This is especially useful when viewing objects in combo boxes and other one-column lists, the display name should be used.  DisplayName is usually a non-persistent field.

fields.name: ACEStatus
fields.FieldDescription:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure)
Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.

Value	Name	                Meaning
1	ACESuccess	after commit event completed successfully
2	ACEFSuccess	an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully
3	ACEFFail	                an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event
> 99	<custom status>	User specific status codes (Designer based)

fields.FieldDescription: The flag indicates whether a transaction was initiated by an external application, such as through a REST API call. However, when the flag is set to true, it serves as a control mechanism to prevent broadcasting the transaction data. This indicates that the transaction was executed externally, and therefore, should not be broadcast back.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.FieldDescription: DisplayName is the field generally used to represent an object in a user interface, especially when the user interface needs to represent an object with just one data element.  For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object.   The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character.   This is especially useful when viewing objects in combo boxes and other one-column lists, the display name should be used.  DisplayName is usually a non-persistent field.

fields.name: DataCollectionDef
fields.FieldDescription: The Data Collection Definition used to define the parametric data fields to collect and place in ParametricData.  If there is only one reference to this specific service in the Spec TransactionMap, InSite will fill in this field automatically.  If a service exists multiple times in the TransactionMap, the user will need to input which data collection definition they are using.  For instance, the CollectData service might be entered twice on the TransactionMap, once with parameters recorded every hour, and once with parameters recorded every ten minutes.  When the user is performing the ColllectData, the user would then need to specify which kind of data collection they are performing in this field.
